text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
“—Oh my, what seems to be the matter? Do 
you need something? Feel free to ask for 
anything.”

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
No... not right now. I shall wrap things 
up in an hour.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, got it. Then let's have some tea 
after that. I got my hands on some nice 
tea leaves.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...... —Orfe? ...Ah, my apologies. If I'm 
bothering you, I'll step away.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
My sister's gaze... the praise dwelling 
within it brings me comfort. Therefore, I 
do not mind.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Thank you, Orfe. My proud younger 
sister possesses a heart just as 
beautiful...
